source.description:
Hello there, <name>. I've heard much about your exploits, and must say I'm honored to meet you. I don't suppose you've heard the story of Ol' Kelt? Ah, well, Ol' Kelt--Kelt Thomasin, that is--was once considered one of the finest hunters in all the realm. There wasn't much he hadn't done, but then, one day, he became obsessed with an ancient story... a myth, really. Well, as the stories go, a huge threshadon lives in the waters of the lake. Hogwash, if you ask me. If you're interested, you might talk to Kelt.

        See if you've already completed this by typing:

        /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(259))
